name: Fingrom
tagline: Platform-agnostic financial accounting application for personal finance management
blurb: The goal of the solution is to create a financial accounting application that is intuitive, efficient, and inclusive.
description:
The goal of the solution is to create a financial accounting application that is intuitive, efficient, and inclusive.
That empowers users to effortlessly manage their finances while ensuring that no one is left behind.

Features

• Accounting

• Budget Categories

• Bills, Transfers, Incomes (Invoices)

• Goals Definition

• Exchange rates

• Recurring Payments

• Metrics

• Synchronization between devices (P2P)

• Recovery via WebDav or a direct File

• Import from CSV, QIF, OFX files for Bills and Invoices

• Export to Excel (XLSX) file

• Data encryption

• Localizations: EN, BE, PL, PT, FR, DE, UK, ZH, HI, UZ, FA, AR, AZ, JA, ES, IT, TR, KO, NL, CS, RO, KA, RU, ID

• Security: password protection, one-time password, biometrics

• Responsive and Adaptive Design

• Shortcuts

If you would like to come with suggestions, report bugs, translate the app, or contribute otherwise,
feel free to reach out!

This is an "open source code" application that welcomes and values contributions from the community.
However, there are some restrictions when it comes to external modification and distribution, as it follows
the CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0 license. As the author of this project, I agree to abide by the "Terms of Use" and "Privacy
Policy" to ensure the well-being and satisfaction of all users on all platforms (desktop, mobile and web).

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
